invariants.commit: writer fills seq/ticks/args/kind/cpu, then sets COMMITTED with release; reader requires COMMITTED and seq in the retained window
invariants.half_write: non-zero slot without COMMITTED is reported, never decoded
invariants.wrap: slot = seq % 1024; retained range [seq-1023, seq-1] while seq>0
invariants.overwrite_count: dropped counter and retained range only; no host read cursor, so this is not an exact unread-loss count
invariants.cross_cpu: ticks from one arch counter; equal ticks do not imply a total order; seq ordering is only within a CPU
invariants.same_cpu_nesting: the writer reserves a slot before filling it; an interrupt nesting the writer must not reuse the same slot (seq reservation is atomic)
invariants.initial_export: frozen dump only; no concurrent live decode promised
